description: A foundational figure in the first wave of UK Funky, and one of the few Black women producers shaping that sound at its peak, Karen Nyame KG remains rooted in the percussive swing and diasporic rhythm that defined her early output. Epiphany EP captures that DNA fully matured, assured and unapologetically sensual. Diving deep into their melodic bag with a project built for heated dancefloors and sun-drenched festival stages, this is Afro-electronic goodness with weight and intent.
